layout.bed: immediately beside right end of desk; progressively crop on narrow screens
layout.walls: extended bare surface; floor and ceiling positioned separately
layout.responsive: continuous group interpolation; workspace always visible

notes: Source PNGs preserve generated detail and internal self shading. Use SVG silhouette masks to exclude residual soft external glow.
Cast SVGs are independent alpha-derived silhouettes; receiving-surface projection and intensity require adjustment in the assembled scene.

Bed, cupboard, complete plants, lanyard with badge and seated character with chair are each consolidated PNG sprites. Earlier component masters are retained for reference; only assets named in room-layout.ts are rendered.
PC chassis contains internal hardware; glass and fan effects are optional overlays, not a fully exploded internal computer.
Source art is unoptimized. Produce deployment sizes after scene scale is finalized.
